SELECT 
  t.fished_date_doy,
  t.cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats,
  SUM(t.yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(t.anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(t.yt) / (SUM(t.anglers) + 0.0), 2) as avg_yt_per_angler
FROM trips t
WHERE t.fished_date_season = 6 
  AND t.fished_date_doy >= 90 
  AND t.fished_date_doy <= 125
  AND t.avail_t <= 1946.875
GROUP BY t.fished_date_doy, t.cls
ORDER BY t.fished_date_doy, t.cls
LIMIT 100

SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy 
FROM climate 
WHERE index_id = 'oni' AND avail_season = 6
ORDER BY avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / (SUM(anglers) + 0.0), 2) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 6 
  AND fished_date_doy >= 115
  AND fished_date_doy <= 200
  AND avail_t <= 1946.875
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 80
